question: Beta-lactams are the most numerous group of antibiotics. One of the NEGATIVE aspects of this group of antibiotics is:

options.opa: The absence of derivatives that are well absorbed orally.
options.opb: The lack of derivatives with antibacterial activity on pseudomonas aeruginosa.
options.opc: The possibility of any of its derivatives, to produce severe allergic reactions.
options.opd: The need to associate inhibitors of beta-lactamases, to any derivative, to avoid bacterial resistance.
